# EmuTOS 1.4 — complete source code

`emutos-VERSION_1_4.tar.gz` is the official source archive of EmuTOS 1.4
(tag `VERSION_1_4` of <https://github.com/emutos/emutos>), downloaded unmodified.

The emulator uses the **unmodified** EmuTOS 1.4 192 KB UK ROM image (`etos192uk.img`)
from the official release. EmuTOS is free software under the GNU GPL version 2 or later
(see `doc/license.txt` inside the archive). Project site: <https://emutos.sourceforge.io/>.
